---
description: "Assess an app or project and recommend Microsoft IQ only where it fits."
---

Apply the **Project assessment** mode in the
[Microsoft IQ Navigator instructions](../agents/microsoft-iq-navigator.agent.md).
Use the supplied brief, architecture notes, or attached context. If only a
repository path or URL is provided, ask for the relevant content instead of
assuming access. Return the decision table, the smallest useful pilot, and
what to defer. Include the architecture and readiness summary, distinguishing
the IQ capability, host, candidate integration, and prerequisites. Keep
unverified source support and tenant readiness explicit. Do not connect to
any source or make changes.
